sentences.en: I changed the apostrophe to the straight one that we use.
sentences.zh: 1. 我把撇号改成了我们常用的直撇号。

sentences.en: Tatoeba: the only place where the use of different apostrophes is controversial.
sentences.zh: 2. 在塔托埃巴，不同类型的撇号的使用存在争议。

sentences.en: TDK has decided to abolish the use of apostrophe in names of institutions.
sentences.zh: 3. TDK 决定在机构名称中废除撇号的使用。

senses.zh: 省略符号，撇号；呼语，顿呼
